technical_requirements: Latency target: p95 < 200ms for short-chat flows (<= 256 tokens).
Throughput target: steady 150-200 reqs/sec, burst to 450 reqs/sec for 10min windows.
Cost target: reduce per-token cost by 25-40% vs hosted baseline at 200 rps sustained.
Quality guardrails: run 5000 eval prompts before canary; maintain >=95% semantic-similarity score vs baseline.
Model routing: primary = Dedicated Llama2-70B-PTQ -> fallback = Redwood-hosted-Llama2-70B-PTQ -> secondary = lighter Falcon-40B-INT8.
Region failover: primary EU and NA pools; failover policy must preserve session affinity and KV caches when possible.
Rollback policy: automatic rollback to hosted variant if latency p95 degrades >30% OR error rate >1% for 5m window.
Audit/telemetry: token-level cost, per-route latency histograms, per-request model variant tag required.
KMS/HSM: required for encryption-at-rest of cached prompts and logs.
Proof of compatibility with internal SSO and SCIM provisioning during POC.
